mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM health_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM health_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND recorded_at >= #{startTime} ORDER BY recorded_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_record (user_id, systolic, diastolic, blood_sugar, heart_rate, weight, bmi, memo, recorded_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{systolic}, #{diastolic}, #{bloodSugar}, #{heartRate}, #{weight}, #{bmi}, #{memo}, #{recordedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE health_record SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM health_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(recorded_at) = #{date}
